tasks.behavior: Record a pinned public EDGAR reference baseline in local-only notes, with install notes, tool inventory, and fixture results.
acceptance: Local-only reference notes exist with install, inventory, and fixture results.

tasks.behavior: Interview at least six prospective users across three target groups using concrete research tasks and select initial acceptance workflows.
acceptance: Six interviews, ranked needs, and three agreed release workflows are recorded.

tasks.behavior: Inventory reuse, licenses, and dependency choices against the pinned public-reference baseline.
acceptance: Attribution plan, approved dependencies, and recorded exceptions exist in local-only notes and a public-safe docs/upstream.md.

tasks.behavior: Complete entity, fact, period, source, and coverage contracts, including ambiguity and missingness rules.
acceptance: Reviewed schemas, examples, and ambiguity/missingness rules exist beyond the initial domain type layout.

tasks.behavior: Create an independent golden source fixture corpus whose expected outputs are not generated by the implementation under test.
acceptance: Expected numeric and cutoff values are stored with original filing hashes and reviewer identity.

tasks.behavior: Finish public contract generation (JSON Schema/OpenAPI) and remaining repository bootstrap items after reuse and domain contracts are decided.
acceptance: Generated public schemas, remaining CI contract checks, and a readable handoff exist for Phase 0 exit.

tasks.behavior: Spike official MCP adapters and static chart output from fixture data.
acceptance: One fixture workflow runs over stdio and HTTP with PNG/text fallback.

tasks.behavior: Build the SEC fetch broker with coordinated pacing, retries, coalescing, and fail-closed uncoordinated calls.
acceptance: Concurrency, retries, failover, identity, and block-page tests pass.

tasks.behavior: Implement immutable source storage and atomic manifests.
acceptance: Hash verification, atomic publication, and source-version replay work.

tasks.behavior: Implement entity resolution and historical filing discovery.
acceptance: Ambiguity handling, old-history traversal, pagination, and coverage fixtures pass.

tasks.behavior: Implement document extraction and stable source anchors.
acceptance: Section/text evidence, malformed input limits, and source links are tested.

tasks.behavior: Implement raw fact ingestion that preserves exact decimal lexemes.
acceptance: Lossless values and units are retained through storage.

tasks.behavior: Implement local dataset versions and a query isolation spike.
acceptance: Restart recovery works and unauthorized inputs are denied.

tasks.behavior: Complete one source-to-chart vertical slice on a supported company.
acceptance: A fresh local install can retrieve a filing, produce a sourced metric chart, export, restart, and inspect citations.

tasks.behavior: Review the local alpha, measure gaps, and re-estimate remaining phases.
acceptance: Measured gaps, updated risks, and next-phase acceptance are recorded.

tasks.behavior: Harness plumbing: native runner tests, typecheck, lint, and domain constant tests remain executable. This is not product acceptance.
